reason: The README consistently describes a user-facing DeepSeek Harness web plugin whose primary function is to show per-turn conversation cost and usage metrics (cost, token consumption, cache-hit ratio) directly beneath each AI reply, which maps to UI visualization of runtime data rather than automation, workflow, or external integration.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在 DeepSeek Harness 的每条助手回复下方展示本轮对话的人民币花费、Token 使用量与缓存读占比，帮助你直观看到对话成本。
summaries.en: This plugin shows a per-turn cost and usage summary below each assistant reply in DeepSeek Harness, including cost, token usage, and cache-hit ratio for quick cost visibility.

capabilities: Displays per-turn cost, token usage, and cache-hit details in the chat UI
Parses DeepSeek session usage data to compute a single cost summary per conversation turn
Renders the cost summary inline with assistant reply action area so it is visible in normal chat flow
